column3: Kuroneko Route · The Noise of the Cyber City
Well, I've arrived in Akihabara, but... where are they?
Oh! Isn't that Kyousuke-shi?
Oh... Ahh! W-What a coincidence, hahaha!
...Huh?
Yo.
W-Why...
Uwah... she's clearly getting flustered now that I'm here...
This is expected, since the one she told to "stay away" is now right in front of her.
...Why is senpai here, I wonder?
Ah, actually...
What a coincidence! This must be a strange stroke of fate!
Hey hey, isn't this becoming a little too obvious?
Kyousuke-shi, if you have the time, would you care to join us both for some shopping?
Sure, that's fine with me, but...
That's great. How about you Kuroneko-shi?
We met by coincidence... T-Then it can't be helped.
That's how it should be!
...Let's go, we can't be wasting time here.
Understood!
Well then, let's go!
Still, I didn't think that she would agree to it that easily.
Huhuhu, I'm sure that Kuroneko-shi is also secretly delighted.
Really? I wouldn't think so, judging from her prior attitude.
I didn't see anything that would indicate otherwise.
I think you should get a new pair of glasses, Saori.
...Here we are.
Does this place sell things like art supplies?
How ignorant, just keep quiet and follow us.
Isn't this a shop that deals with electronics and games?
It's the best shop in Akiba for digital drawing tools!
Ah, I see...
I'm heading in.
Agreed!
Ah, wait for me!
Oh, the shape of this tablet pen is quite unique.
It's designed with ergonomics in mind. Even if you use it for a while, your hands won't get tired.
I see, this looks like it would be most useful during crunch times.
Yes. However, you must pay attention to the wear and tear of the pen tip. That's why it's better to buy spare ones as well.
...What kind of alien language are they talking in?
I can't follow along with their conversation at all...
If this goes on, it looks like I won't be able to fulfill my goal of talking to Kuroneko... What should I do?
If you have a spare budget, it's best to buy a transparent screen overlay too, so the pen strokes can come out prettier.
Hoho, I see. That's pretty impressive. I focus on hand drawings more than digital drawings, so I didn't know much about it.
I have a profound respect for your vast knowledge, wouldn't you agree Kyousuke-shi?
Eh!? Ah, yeah, that's right. It's amazing that you know that much.
...This is all merely common knowledge.
That's not the case. You're very knowledgeable about the usage of specific tools.
Which means you use them a lot at home, right?
No, I try them in places like these until I get the hang of them.
I-I see.
To get the best results, it's natural to try them out thoroughly.
I-I guess so...
So is she in a bad mood after all...?
Hmm, I can't figure her out...
Well then... I feel like we've seen enough of everything here. It's time to pay for the items.
Say, since the register is a bit crowded, could the two of you wait outside for a while?
I understand, I'll leave it to you.
Much appreciated! Well then!
Saori... you're as reliable as always.
I won't waste this opportunity you gave me!
Now it's time to try and talk to Kuroneko...
Let's go.
Ah, yeah.
Akihabara sure is crowded today.
That's right.
Feels a little tiring waiting for Saori, though.
That's right.
Also, it seems like Saori isn't coming yet...
That's right.
I-I can't continue the conversation! Crap... what should I do?
...You lied, didn't you?
